svg.title: Four Gates Before Thought Leadership Gets Budget
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-thought-leadership-gates; chapter number: 5; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Gates Before Thought Leadership Gets Budget; subtitle: Live extraction, real metrics, ad thresholds, podcast vetting; caption: Thought leadership pre-sells deals only when the principal's own point of view is extracted live and published consistently.; assumptions note: Gate order is a sequencing convention; each threshold is quoted from the named operator and may differ by account and market.; note: Sources - Social-Hire.com (VesCkYBJkFA), ZenPilot (-zNdXXrY9lU), Adam Holmgren (eFSMGI_UK38), AI InterConnect (Ls08sYL9pzQ), Dylan Conroy (yja0j6pWgP0).; nodes: gate: G1; question: Has the ghostwriter extracted the principal's insights on a live call?; pass next: G2; fail action: Publish nothing under the executive's name; anything else is guessing (Social-Hire.com).; gate: G2; question: Is reporting built on net-new ICP engagement, qualified leads and MRR rather than likes?; pass next: G3; fail action: Hold cadence and budget flat (ZenPilot).; gate: G3; question: Does the thought leader ad clear 10% CTR, with landing-page clicks at 10% or more of social actions?; pass next: G4; fail action: Kill the ad (Adam Holmgren).; gate: G4; question: Has the paid podcast slot passed the STAGE score and a 30-day posting-activity check?; pass next: Fund the slot and send ICP guest invites, which drew 25 to 45% response versus 1 to 3% for cold email (Dylan Conroy).; fail action: No money moves (AI InterConnect).

text.title: Four Gates Before Thought Leadership Gets Budget
text.tspan: Four Gates Before Thought Leadership Gets Budget

rect.title: gate: G1; question: Has the ghostwriter extracted the principal's insights on a live call?; pass next: G2; fail action: Publish nothing under the executive's name; anything else is guessing (Social-Hire.com).
gate: G2; question: Is reporting built on net-new ICP engagement, qualified leads and MRR rather than likes?; pass next: G3; fail action: Hold cadence and budget flat (ZenPilot).
gate: G3; question: Does the thought leader ad clear 10% CTR, with landing-page clicks at 10% or more of social actions?; pass next: G4; fail action: Kill the ad (Adam Holmgren).

gate: G4; question: Has the paid podcast slot passed the STAGE score and a 30-day posting-activity check?; pass next: Fund the slot and send ICP guest invites, which drew 25 to 45% response versus 1 to 3% for cold email (Dylan Conroy).; fail action: No money moves (AI InterConnect).

text.title: Assumptions: Gate order is a sequencing convention; each threshold is quoted from the named operator and may differ by account and market.
